summary: Institutional positioning is heavily skewed toward long-term bullishness on the broad market, evidenced by massive $1B+ accumulations in SPX 7000C and 8000C strikes expiring as far out as 2031. High-conviction directional bets are also visible in the semiconductor and tech sectors, with extreme call dominance in AMD (P/C 0.20), META (P/C 0.34), and MSTR (P/C 0.09). Persistent multi-day interest is concentrated in SPX 200C and 1200C (exp 2026) and the SPX 7000C (exp 2031) series, signaling massive, multi-session capital deployment into long-dated equity upside. Traders should watch for continued strength in semi-conductors (MU, AMD) and monitor if the SPX 8000P (exp 2027) $218.6M position acts as a hedge or a signal of volatility expansion.
